subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram channel can be wedged by bad persisted session JSON; status should detect and offer recovery

question: Should bad Telegram/session-store JSON recovery be diagnostic-only, an explicit backup-first reset command, or automatic quarantine on load?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the recovery mode changes operator control, persisted session continuity, and the boundary with generic session-store recovery in #77783/#79910.

options.title: Diagnostic plus explicit reset
options.body: Status or doctor reports file health and points to a backup-first reset command, keeping destructive action operator-controlled.

options.title: Diagnostic only
options.body: Status or doctor reports corrupt or oversized state and safe manual steps while leaving reset automation for a later issue.

options.title: Automatic quarantine
options.body: The gateway moves bad state aside and recreates state on load, maximizing recovery but taking the largest compatibility and continuity risk.

recommendation.title: Diagnostic plus explicit reset
recommendation.body: Status or doctor reports file health and points to a backup-first reset command, keeping destructive action operator-controlled.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Telegram status diagnostic commits make this the strongest owner signal for the product-direction choice.
